title: Intern- Rio
description:
Job Description
ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. Interns will work at the local ABS Consulting Office.
What You Will Do:
The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
Engineering Plan Review.
Technical Plan Review.
Research and Product Development.
Operational Safety and Evaluation.
Data Science and Digital Services
Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in progress in Chemical Engineering (other related Engineering degrees – e.g., Mechanical, Production, Safety, Process – may be considered).
Currently enrolled from the 6th semester (or equivalent) onwards.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Strong interest in risk analysis, process safety and process engineering, especially in sectors such as marine/offshore, oil & gas and mining.
Availability to work 30 hours per week (e.g., 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday), during business hours.
Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) – especially Excel for data treatment and KPI/risk indicator analysis.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English (and Portuguese).
Organization, attention to detail and interest in quality, risk and safety from a systems and process perspective.
Analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data, engineering information and risk scenarios.
Proactivity and curiosity to understand client processes, technologies and risk scenarios in marine/offshore, oil & gas, mining and other industrial sectors.
Attention to detail and rigor in technical documentation, records and analyses.
Teamwork and collaboration, with ability to interact with multidisciplinary technical teams (engineering, operations, safety, quality, etc.).
Good organizational skills to manage multiple analytical tasks and deadlines.
Ethical behavior, focus on safety and alignment with ABS values of integrity and responsibility.
It would be nice if you had:
Academic or extracurricular experience related to process safety, risk assessment, reliability, process simulation or industrial operations.
Basic understanding of risk analysis methods (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, Bow-tie, LOPA, FMEA) and/or management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO – even if only from university courses.
Familiarity with process flowcharts, PFDs, P&IDs and basic process engineering concepts (mass/energy balance, unit operations, etc.).
Experience with spreadsheets and basic data analysis (advanced Excel, simple dashboards, basic BI tools) is a plus.
Reporting Relationships:
You'll work alongside engineer colleagues reporting into a Senior Manager. colleguages
Important: This internship does not involve laboratory activities . It is a position focused on theoretical and analytical work , risk and process evaluation, data analysis and technical documentation.
About Us
We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We're at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

description:

description:
Job Description
Do you have a strong telecom engineering background and experience working with international customers? Do you want to be part of a global consulting organization while supporting a world-class telecom provider? Then this role is for you.
Tietoevry Create is looking for a Senior Telco Service Engineer to work on a strategic engagement with BICS, a global leader in international communications services. You will operate in a customer-facing, technically demanding role, ensuring high-quality service delivery across BICS' international telecom portfolio.
This position is based in Rio de Janeiro and operates in a global, multicultural environment, working closely with international customers and cross-functional teams.
Your Responsibilities
Act as the main operational point of contact for selected international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' telecom services.
Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive engagement and customized operational interfaces, in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.
Prepare and present monthly service performance reports and lead Service Review Meetings, driving continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.
Serve as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents and escalations, coordinating resolution activities and delivering formal RFO/RCA documentation.
Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, supporting adoption of BICS' global offerings.
Collect and share customer feedback internally to support operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
Develop and maintain operational documentation, including service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices.
Who We Are Looking For
Solid experience in the telecom industry, combining strong technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities.
Proven technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and structured approach.
Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage complex service issues and escalations.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.
University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.
Flexibility and accountability, including willingness to travel internationally when required.
Strong crisis and incident management capabilities.
As a person, you are reliable, structured, and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and value operational discipline and continuous improvement.
We also value
Experience working with international enterprise or carrier customers.
Familiarity with SLA-driven service environments and operational reporting.
Ability to work closely with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
We offer
Professional growth within a global consulting organization.
Long-term, meaningful projects with leading international clients.
Open and collaborative culture with strong knowledge sharing.
Flexible hybrid work model and focus on work-life balance.
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.
Additional Information
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: GSD) Integration Manager – People Technology
description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team
The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda's office infrastructure and staff connectivity. We provide the hardware, software, and access to resources that allow staff to achieve their goals. We operate in 10 different countries, providing 24/7 support to all Agoda employees. Whether in the office, working remotely, or traveling, we enable everyone to stay connected. The GSD team uses state-of-the-art cloud management technologies combined with the best on-site services to manage the latest hardware running Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The Opportunity:
Agoda is using a wide range of systems and tools like Workday, Zendesk, Greenhouse, etc. to support its People operations' fast-moving pace and dynamic workforce needs globally. We are looking for a People Technology Manager (Integrations) to drive projects and implement solutions at scale to simplify work, automate repetitive tasks, and optimize business processes. In this role, you will be a key driver of Agoda's People Technology strategy, owning critical integrations and automations that directly impact every employee's experience. You'll work at the intersection of HR, Payroll, and Technology, with the freedom to innovate and the scale to see your solutions make a measurable difference
In This Role, You'll Get To
Lead a team of SMEs to drive People Technology integration projects.
Own and lead Agoda's payroll integration roadmap, shaping how core HR and payroll systems work together across countries and products.
Strategize Agoda's Workday integration roadmap by scaling solutions, driving continuous improvements, and assessing platform readiness.
Lead integration design strategy using Workday and other tools, integrating with platforms such as Zendesk, Greenhouse, Oracle, and other components of the Agoda tech stack.
Optimize existing automated solutions to improve efficiency and create leaner processes.
Partner closely with key business stakeholders (Payroll, FinSys, People Technology, BI Dev) to assess technology needs and feasibility, align priorities, manage timelines, and drive end-to-end delivery from design through testing and deployment.
Explore creative and out-of-the-box solutions to solve complex business problems.
Implement, test, and launch major system enhancements, ensuring quality, stability, and a smooth change experience for end users.
Collaborate with solutions and engineering teams to design and implement custom applications and tools that extend Workday and the broader People Tech ecosystem.
Mentor and coach junior team members, sharing best practices and elevating the overall technical capabilities of the team.
Lead system-related training and demos for Agoda employees and People Team end users, driving adoption of new tools, features, and ways of working.
What You'll Need to Succeed:
Minimum +8 years of hands-on Workday Integrations experience
Experience managing and leading a team
Proven track record leading technical implementations for payroll integration rollouts, specifically using PECI
Strong expertise with Workday integration and reporting tools, including Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, BIRT, RaaS, and REST/SOAP API-based integrations
Solid knowledge of Workday Core HCM and other key functional/technical areas, such as Business Processes, Security, and system configuration
Deep understanding of integration design patterns, error handling, and Workday data models
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, proactively identifying and resolving edge cases, dependencies, and potential risks
Strong team player with a high sense of ownership, bringing subject-matter expertise while collaborating to solve complex issues
Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvements to simplify processes, increase scalability, and reduce operational complexity
Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging cross-functional teams
Ability to leverage data and analytics to generate insights and support effective decision-making
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required
It's Great If You Have:
Experience in automation tools and programming languages outside of Workday space (MS Power Apps, SQL, HTML)
Ability to constructively challenge and refine requests while maintaining respectful, professional relationships
Presentation/Workshop facilitation
Able to move fast, adapt to changes

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Match Affinity
Match Affinity is a division of Match Group that drives the fastest growing dating apps. Every month, millions of users come to our apps, like BLK and Chispa, to find matches and make great connections.
The Role
As a Data Analyst on our Product Analytics Team, you'll use data to understand our users -- what they need, what they do, how to retain them, and ultimately how to help them find the best dates. Then you will partner with cross-functional teams to provide long-term strategic insights for our products. You will also support business trends/forecasting and model the financial impact of new product ideas.

A strong knowledge querying massive and complex datasets, analyzing, and driving key and actionable insights
Working with other cross-functional teams like Finance, CRM, Engineering and Business Intelligence; proactively engage other teams to identify and drive better user experience
Providing internal consulting to product management, marketing, finance, and CRM teams on A/B tests as they move initiatives from concept to market
Presenting technical content across business stakeholders
Working as the product owner of revenue and retention strategies for the product
Serving as the subject matter expert on applying various statistical methodologies towards distilling actionable insights
Researching issues about customer behavior/changes by analyzing relevant metrics, trends and supporting enterprise level initiatives
Supporting these products: Chispa, BLK, Upward, Yuzu
You might be a Match if you have:
3+ years of hands on SQL (or structured data) experience along with advanced Excel Skills
Exposure to applied statistics (descriptive statistics, statistical testing, design of experiments, linear modeling, time series analysis etc); Python/SPSS/SAS/R experience a plus
Self-starter with good communications skills
You have experience going beyond number-crunching, reports, and dashboard creation -- you are able to understand the business impact of the data and make recommendations based on your findings
Excellent problem solving skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics,Economics, Computer Science, Engineering related field, Marketing, or MBA with quantitative focus
Experience in product analytics supporting digital applications including mobile apps & consumer internet is preferred
Fluent English is required

About Us
GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil (Hybrid)
GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.
Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world's largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.
Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.
GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

Support legal entity administration and maintain compliance record for local operations.
Assist in drafting and reviewing statutory and other corporate documents and provide basic support on corporate law matters under supervision.
Coordinate with internal business and operations including credit, tax, treasury, operations, etc. in connection with legal reviews.
Conduct basic legal research and provide guidance on regulatory requirements applicable to Peridot's business globally.
Correspond with local counsel regarding documentation and team questions and coordinate review by such counsel.

Fluent Portuguese, English and Spanish;
Bachelor or university degree in law (or equivalent);
Work experience: 1 year of experience in legal support, contracts or corporate law;
Basic knowledge of contract law and corporate governance;
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail;

title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
Join Our Team
Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.
We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.
About the Role:
We are looking for a QA Analyst (Manual Testing) to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of web-based applications through thorough manual testing practices. This role is ideal for someone who is who is detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about identifying issues before they reach end-users.
You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, validating requirements, executing test cases, and clearly documenting findings. The role requires strong communication skills, a solid understanding of QA fundamentals, and the ability to work in dynamic environments where quality and collaboration are critical.
Responsibilities:
Execute manual test cases to validate functionality, usability, and performance
Review requirements and specifications to ensure test coverage
Identify, document, and track defects using bug tracking tools
Perform regression, smoke, and exploratory testing
Collaborate closely with developers and product teams to clarify issues and validate fixes
Ensure testing activities align with the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Maintain clear and accurate testing documentation
Must Have:
Previous experience in Quality Assurance, with a strong focus on manual testing
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Experience testing web-based applications (mobile testing is a plus)
Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar)
Ability to communicate findings clearly and professionally
Nice to Have:
Experience with mobile application testing
Exposure to basic test case design techniques
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum environments
Interest in expanding toward automation testing in the future

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final

Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.
InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.
The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.
**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.
Duties
Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
Carry out national and international trips, as needed
Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders
Required
Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
Active CREA registration
Desirable post-graduation in a related area
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
Good vision and business understanding
Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
Expertise in installation analysis
Experience using OrcaFlex software
Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time. title: Business Operations Associate
description:
Company Description
Evergreen Permits specializes in helping homeowners, contractors, and developers in Seattle simplify the permitting process for small residential remodeling projects. With a team of experienced architects and designers, we ensure compliance with local building codes while saving our clients time and effort. Our services include creating as-built drawings, architectural drafting, detailed documentation, and managing seamless permit submissions. Our mission is to take the hassle out of the paperwork, making remodel projects straightforward and stress-free for our clients.
We're a small (but growing) architectural permit services company building a smarter, faster way to serve contractors and other blue-collar builders—an audience that's been overlooked for way too long.
This role is for someone who thrives on building structure from scratch: systems, workflows, SOPs, and the day-to-day operations that keep everything moving. Early on, you'll wear multiple hats. Over time, the systems you help create will become standalone roles as we scale.
What you'll own (initially)
Answering phone calls and returning missed calls
Sales calls (not pushy sales calls, just explaining what we do)
CRM implementation + management (pipeline hygiene, automations, reporting)
Screening web submissions and routing qualified leads to the sales team
Coordinating with marketing team
Building systems and SOPs across the company so we can train future hires fast
Meeting regularly with the owner to plan, build, and improve these systems together
Who we're looking for:
Excellent spoken English. You will be talking to potential customers very often and communication is key for this role
Ability to work during Seattle business hours - 8am-5pm PST / 1pm-10pm GMT-3
You are self-motivated and autonomous—you don't need constant direction
You like creating order: checklists, templates, systems, and repeatable processes
You're comfortable using modern tools such as: CRM (Hubspot or similar), Monday, Microsoft Suite, Excel, Word, automation tools like Zapier, understanding project boards & scheduling tools.
You're a kind person. We're a curated group of highly motivated people that respect and show kindness to others. We want to learn from you and visa-versa
You're excited about using AI thoughtfully to move faster and work smarter
You communicate clearly, follow through, and keep things organized
Bonus if you've supported a founder, managed operations, or helped implement a CRM before
Why this role is different
You'll be building the operational foundation of a company with real momentum—helping turn a messy early stage into a machine we can scale.
Qualifications
Strong Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills
Exceptional Phone Etiquette and Communication Skills
Experience in Executive Administrative Assistance
Proficiency in using office software and organizational tools
Ability to work independently in a remote environment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Prior experience in a permitting, architecture, or construction-related field is a plus
Benefits
Remote contractor role with autonomy to manage your day while collaborating closely with our US team.
Pay: between R$ 3,200 – R$ 4,000 depending on experience
Competitive starting pay depending on experience.
Two weeks of paid time off per year plus eight paid US holidays (you may swap any holiday for one you observe) and one week off in December for a total of around 1 month PTO.
Ongoing mentoring by the owner, process improvement, and client management.
Clear career path—grow into senior role starting on the ground floor of an exciting one of a kind company
We're an early-stage company fulfilling a clear demand in the building and construction industry, so joining us now means getting in on the ground floor with plenty of room to move up as we scale.

title: Analista de Comunicação
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:
A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.
DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:
O Analista de Comunicação terá a responsabilidade de oferecer suporte abrangente em todas as áreas relacionadas a comunicação da Filial do Rio de Janeiro. Isso inclui redação de conteúdos de divulgação, elaboração de apresentações institucionais e de projetos, cobertura audiovisual de atividades com captação e edição de imagens e vídeos editados com e sem depoimento, criação de plano de comunicação e marketing dos projetos junto aos financiadores, elaboração de materiais de marketing dos projetos. É importante ter habilidade em planejamento e gerenciamento de campanhas de comunicação e marketing.
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:
Apoiar na criação e elaboração de apresentações e portifólio de projetos para stakeholders e patrocinadores.
Colaborar ativamente na divulgação de projetos em andamento e no registro detalhado das atividades desenvolvidas.
Criar e propor materiais de comunicação em linha com as diretrizes de Comunicação da AVSI Brasil e financiadores.
Auxiliar na criação de materiais gráficos dos projetos.
Realizar a cobertura audiovisual das atividades dos projetos com captação e edição de imagens e vídeos editados com e sem depoimentos.

title: Técnico em Saúde Bucal
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil? Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas. Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil. Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco. O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada. Sobre a oportunidade:Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como:segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas. Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar as Cefalometrias e as fotos para realizar a documentação de Ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário. Realização de procedimentos básicos juntos aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiografias) sempre com supervisão do Dentista. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior. Curso técnico TSB concluído + CRO ATIVO. Horário:Segunda á sexta dás 09h ás 18h e sábado dás 09h ás 13h.

Realizar a limpeza, higienização e organização dos apartamentos e demais áreas da unidade, garantindo a arrumação geral, troca de roupa de cama, retirada de lixo, e a higienização de banheiros e pisos. Também será necessário, quando solicitado, efetuar a limpeza das áreas comuns e externas.
Vistoriar os quartos durante o check-out, assegurando que o estoque de roupas esteja completo e verificando a integridade de peças e equipamentos. description:
DESCRIÇÃO
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?
Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas.
Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil.
Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível.
Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.
O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.
Sobre a Oportunidade
Realiza coleta dos materiais nos consultórios para esterilização diária e guarda em lugar específico, para utilização dos profissionais / Dentistas, realiza a Limpeza e higienização dos consultórios, em específico, cadeiras, cuspideiras entre outros itens necessários e pertinentes a atividade; realiza a conferência diária dos equipamentos (consultórios, central de esterilização/ autoclaves) a fim de que estejam em perfeito funcionamento, realizando a comunicação ao responsável imediato das irregularidades, formalizando as solicitações de manutenção junto ao movdesk (ferramenta específica empresa); realiza as atividades em atendimento as regras de segurança do trabalho e garantindo atendimento as normas de fiscalização e vigilância sanitária. Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos, fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas, fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional. Zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação e compra dos materiais emergenciais para clínica. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Oportunidade para o Banco Guanabara localizado na Barra da Tijuca - RJ
Conheça mais através do site:
MISSÃO DO CARGO
Assegurar a integridade, a tempestividade e a conformidade das demonstrações contábeis do Banco Guanabara, traduzindo os eventos econômicos em informações confiáveis e relevantes para a gestão e para os órgãos reguladores (Bacen/CMN), apoiando a tomada de decisão da Diretoria e a efetividade dos controles internos, em aderência ao COSIF e às normas CPC/IFRS aplicáveis.
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES
Executar, revisar e conciliar lançamentos contábeis no sistema, em conformidade com os CPCs, normas do Bacen/CMN e plano de contas COSIF (grupos 1 a 9), assegurando rastreabilidade por meio de controles analíticos e documentação de suporte.
Apurar tributos (ISS, PIS, COFINS, IOF, IRPJ e CSLL), emitir guias de pagamento, realizar conciliações fiscais contábeis e garantir o correto enquadramento tributário.
Constituir, revisar e reverter provisões contábeis (contingências, provisões para perdas, entre outras).
Preparar, validar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (ECD e ECF), assegurando trilhas de auditoria e conciliações com o razão geral e livros auxiliares.
Elaborar e enviar obrigações regulatórias com impacto contábil (ex.: SCR, Doc. 3050, Doc. 4010, entre outras), em alinhamento com as áreas de Riscos, Controles Internos e Negócios.
Atender auditorias internas e externas, organizando PBCs, respondendo aos papéis de trabalho, prestando suporte aos testes e acompanhando recomendações e pontos de melhoria.
Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão das demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DMPL, DFC e Notas Explicativas), garantindo consistência entre saldos, demonstrativos e notas.
Realizar análises gerenciais, elaborar indicadores e relatórios para a Diretoria, propondo ajustes e insights para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Cumprir e zelar pelo cronograma de fechamento contábil, sugerindo melhorias de processos e automações que aumentem a eficiência, a conformidade e a qualidade das informações.
REQUISITOS
Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo.
Conhecimento do COSIF: plano de contas (grupos 1 a 9), natureza, função das contas e conciliações analíticas.
Domínio das obrigações fiscais: apuração e emissão de guias de IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IOF e ISS, bem como conciliações fiscais contábeis.
Experiência com obrigações acessórias: ECD e ECF (validação, cruzamentos e trilhas de auditoria).
Conhecimento em demonstrações financeiras: elaboração e reconciliação de BP, DRE, DMPL, DFC e

title: Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Home Office
description:
Vaga de Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Home Office em Rio de Janeiro. R$ 1.500,00 a R$ 3.500,00 (Bruto mensal). Período Integral. Autônomo Área e especialização profissional: Comercial, Vendas - Atendimento Nível hierárquico: Operacional Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro, RJ Regime de contratação de tipo Autônomo Jornada Período Integral Estamos selecionando vendedores(as) por ligação para integrar um time enxuto, estruturado e orientado a performance, atuando em modelo home office, diretamente com leads quentes (clientes que já demonstraram interesse pelo produto).
Esta vaga é EXCLUSIVAMENTE para vendas por ligação.
Não se trata de atendimento por WhatsApp. O WhatsApp é apenas a porta de entrada do lead. O fechamento acontece por telefone, com ligação imediata assim que o cliente demonstra interesse.
O profissional será responsável por ligar para todos os clientes interessados, conduzir a conversa com clareza, esclarecer dúvidas, gerar confiança e realizar o fechamento da venda. Não há prospecção fria. Os leads chegam prontos, e o diferencial da operação está na agilidade e qualidade da ligação.
A atuação ocorre principalmente em horário comercial, das 8h às 17h, em regime home office, exigindo disponibilidade integral e atenção constante aos atendimentos. No entanto, chegam leads também fora desse horário, e atuar nesses momentos é um grande diferencial competitivo, pois quanto mais leads atendidos e mais vendas realizadas, maior é o ganho financeiro. Profissionais focados costumam aproveitar esses atendimentos extras justamente para aumentar significativamente a própria renda.
Os leads devem ser ligados no momento em que entram, sem atrasos. Esta não é uma vaga compatível com outro trabalho simultâneo e não se trata de renda extra. É uma oportunidade para quem busca renda principal, com potencial de ganho elevado.
O trabalho é realizado com nutracêuticos voltados à saúde, especificamente produtos que auxiliam com sintomas relacionados à próstata aumentada. O profissional deve ter maturidade, postura profissional e ausência de constrangimento para falar sobre o tema de forma clara, ética e responsável. Todo o treinamento técnico e comercial será fornecido.
Esta é uma vaga 100% comissionada, sem salário fixo. O modelo de ganho é meritocrático, com comissão escalonada, onde quanto maior o desempenho em vendas por ligação, maior o ganho financeiro. A operação possui alta demanda e clientes interessados diariamente, o que gera potencial real de ganhos elevados para quem executa bem.
Buscamos pessoas com experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente vendas por ligação, sendo considerado um diferencial importante já ter atuado em call center, lidando com alto volume de ligações e metas. É essencial ter resiliência emocional, foco em resultados e capacidade de manter ritmo intenso de chamadas.
Não é uma vaga para quem procura estabilidade, renda complementar ou rotina previsível. É indicada para profissionais que querem fazer das vendas por ligação sua atividade principal, em modelo home office, com foco em resultado, consistência e crescimento financeiro.

title: Sr Customer Enablement Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
The Role
AspenTech is looking for a new Sr Customer Enablement Specialist in Rio de Janeiro. This role will serve as a central coordination hub across multidisciplinary teams including geoscientists, data management professionals, software specialists, and client stakeholders, to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of Upstream projects using AspenTech's Subsurface Science & Engineering software suites.
This is a high-impact opportunity to directly support one of Aspen Technology's largest and most strategic customers in Latin America while contributing to Aspen Technology's continued growth and success in the region.
Your Impact
Provide loyalty-inspiring customer service that drives user engagement and sustains product usage.
Serve as the primary coordination point between geoscientists, data management teams, software specialists, and customer stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery aligned with defined scope, schedule, quality, and contractual commitments.
Track and manage project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies, proactively escalating issues and driving resolution within Aspen Technology.
Facilitate and support project governance activities, including planning sessions, technical workshops, and regular status meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, identifying and communicating potential risks or gaps to management in a timely manner.
Prepare and deliver activity reports, project updates, and status communications to customers and internal management as required.
Provide timely and accurate KPI reporting for operations, financial, and corporate requirements.
Collaborate with other Aspen Technology functions to maintain and develop business opportunities.
Develop strong relationships with Customer, building an understanding of their business needs and operational challenges.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of project coordination practices, delivery workflows, and customer engagement models.
What You'll Need
Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Data Science or Geosciences.
Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience in IT, engineering, data science or geoscience related disciplines. University experience may count.
Experience managing Upstream Data
Experience coordinating Upstream Projects across multidisciplinary technical teams, including geoscientists, data management professionals and software specialists.
Familiarity with methodologies, tools, and best practices for tracking milestones, risks, and deliverables.
Experience creating dashboard and reporting metrics to track project performance and operational KPIs.
Familiarity with data and workflows to support quantitative seismic inversion projects.
Previous experience working on-site with customers is a plus.
Ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner utilizing strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
Ability to proactively take the leads in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.

title: Product Specialist
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Product Specialist to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

Somos formados por pessoas de diferentes idades e experiências profissionais. No processo de seleção, bem como no desenvolvimento de carreira, aplicamos critérios de não discriminação e igualdade de oportunidades, de acordo com o que recomenda a nossa cultura e nosso Código de Ética e Conduta. A Celeo apoia diversos projetos de cultura, educação, bem-estar, saúde, ações de cidadania, solidariedade, entre outros com o compromisso com a sociedade e acreditando que juntos formamos um time mais forte. Reconhecemos a importância das pessoas para o nosso negócio e buscamos diariamente a construção de ambientes propícios ao desenvolvimento, segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, terceiros e prestadores de serviços, e ainda, da população próxima aos nossos empreendimentos, nos tornando um ótimo lugar para trabalhar todos os dias com #orgulhodeserceleo.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar nas atividades relacionadas a gestão de ativos, no controle e melhorias dos ativos de transmissão com 5.239 km de linhas e 61 subestações de 500/230kV, presente em 10 estados. E atuação em ativos de geração com 6 usinas fotovoltaica com 186MW.
Atuar na análise e aprovação na etapa do cadastro do item pelo solicitante no sistema.
Atuar nas etapas do fluxograma do processo de Gestão de estoque.
Atuar na análise, etapas do processo de Calibração e Manutenção dos instrumentos.
Atuar no acionamento, controle e acompanhamento de ações necessárias das garantias dos ativos.
Atuar no controle, análise, cadastro dos ativos e nas ações necessárias nas Ordem de Serviço (OS) no sistema de Gestão da Manutenção.
Elaborar, automatizar e manter dashboards analíticos e gerenciais em Power BI, contemplando indicadores como: Disponibilidade de ativos, MTTR, MTBF, Backlog crítico, Reincidência de falhas, Perdas energéticas (MWh), Performance e confiabilidade dos ativos;
Criar rotinas de reporte automatizadas, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando a periodicidade e confiabilidade das análises
Desenvolver modelos analíticos e preditivos utilizando ferramentas de analise de dados, incluindo: Análise de tendência e degradação, Probabilidade de falha, Risco de indisponibilidade, Detecção de anomalias, Apoio à manutenção baseada em condição;
Aplicar conceitos de Confiabilidade de Ativos nas análises de dados, como: Criticidade, Modos e efeitos de falha, Ciclo de vida dos ativos, Integridade e risco operacional;
Atuar na modelagem e padronização de dados de ativos, incluindo: Hierarquia e cadastro de ativos, Eventos e ordens de manutenção, Localização, Criticidade e classificação;
Outras atividades delegadas pela coordenação/gerência pertinentes ao cargo.
Requisitos e qualificações
Necessário:
Ensino Superior completo (qualquer curso);
Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico (MCPSE).
Domínio do Pacote Office e Power BI.
Conhecimento em Python ou similar.
Conhecimento em Análise de dados.
Diferencial:
Ter atuado no setor de Transmissão de Energia.
Conhecimento em conceitos de confiabilidade.
Conhecimento da ISO 55001.
Experiência na área de Gestão de Ativos.

title: técnico de farmacia
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico.
Requisitos e qualificações
Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo
Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia

title: Senior Fraud Auditor- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.
Overview
We are seeking a Fraud Investigator to join the Internal Special Audits Division.
The Internal Special Audits Division is responsible for conducting highly sensitive investigations into issues involving fraud, conflicts of interest, waste, and abuse to provide the management and the Board of Directors with reports, analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed. The Special Audits Division also helps addressing fraud risk management across the Company with programs of awareness, policy and risk consulting, and proactive risk mitigation measures.
Your primary role is to conduct confidential investigations involving misconduct by employees and contractors, while seeking to identify and develop relevant facts.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Lead or support time-sensitive investigations.
Become familiar with and utilize data mining and analytical techniques to both identify potential fraud and gather corroborating evidence to support investigations.
Become familiar with and utilize Enterprise Risk Management tools (i.e., SAP) to obtain data in support of investigations.
Provide fraud awareness presentations throughout the Company to varying job specialties and levels of management.
Liaise and coordinate with other fraud-related stakeholder departments including Corporate Security, Law, Personnel and Labor Relations.
Draft timely investigative reports and verbally communicate results.
Provide on-the-job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
Work independently yet effectively within a team of experienced professionals
Minimum Requirements
As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor degree in accounting, finance, human resources, law, criminology, compliance, computer. an advanced degree is a plus.
You will have a minimum of 10 years of experience in forensic accounting, fraud investigation, auditing, law enforcement, compliance, or a related field where you utilized and developed expert interviewing and investigative techniques.
You will have at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
You must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with solid presentation and interpersonal skills.
You should be able to quickly evaluating allegations of fraud, abuse and conflicts of interest and determine the violation of the law, regulations, or Company policy.
You should have effective and modern investigative techniques to quickly unravel, explain, and report complicated fraud and conflicts of interest schemes.
You should be able analyze facts and evidence and form evidence-based conclusions concerning violations of the law, regulations, or Company policy.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:

About The Role:
The Petroleum Economics Principal Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion . You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.
The Team:
CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprise some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.
Responsibilities And Impact:
Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of excel based models, written reports and presentations. Ensure that the breadth of coverage of Vantage fiscal models covers all types of locations and properties.
Develop stand-alone project level as well as portfolio and company level consolidated cash flow models.
Respond to customer questions of various complexity in assigned geographical regions by providing deep subject matter expertise, timely insight, and good judgement.
Work in close co-operation with colleagues in publishing exciting and timely content.
Collaborate with product management teams to help define what type of results and analysis customers want to see and contribute to the continual development of the Vantage product and its relevant functionality.
Provide expert support to commercial teams, management, and colleagues for the marketing of the Vantage product to contribute to securing and retaining customers.
Continuously develop expertise in a particular practice or focus area and expand knowledge into related fields. Stay abreast of current/hot topics and contribute to written/published products to broaden and build upon subject matter knowledge.
What We're Looking For:
Basic Required Qualifications:
At least a bachelor's degree or studies towards a chartered qualification in economics, finance, tax, accountancy or law is a must. An equivalent combination of experience and education will be considered.
Hands-on experience of constructing, modifying, and reviewing Excel based DCF models (including key financial metrics), ideally of oil and gas upstream and midstream assets.
Experience with / ability to extract fiscal, financial and economic / commercial information from contracts, legislation, etc. and quantify it in the economic models; knowledge of oil and gas upstream fiscal terms / contracts and broader petroleum economics.
Native/Fluent Portuguese Speaker
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Expert level proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated proficiency in functional programming (preferably F#), applying best practices, and producing clean, unit‑tested, maintainable code in a collaborative production environment.
Data analytics tools such as SQL, python, R, or other programming languages knowledge is a plus.
Experience in a similar role and with an oil and gas operator, reserves auditor, consulting, advisory or financial institution.

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.
S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. title: Terapeuta Ocupacional
description:
Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move
Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.
Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.
Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social.
Reforçamos Que Não Solicitamos Pagamentos, Taxas Ou Códigos SMS Em Nossos Processos Seletivos. Todas As Oportunidades Estão Disponíveis Em Nossos Canais Oficiais e No Nosso Site De Carreira. Qualquer Situação Diferente Deve Ser Denunciada. Principais Responsabilidades
Realizar avaliação nos aspectos sensório-motores e cognitivos a fim de identificar limitações na funcionalidade e desempenho ocupacional nas atividades de auto cuidado, instrumentais da vida diária e de vida prática registrando os dados no formulário "Avaliação de Terapia Ocupacional" que deve ser impressa, assinada e constar nº do registro profissional;
Estabelecer objetivos do tratamento terapêutico ocupacional e data de reavaliação a fim de verificar se os objetivos propostos inicialmente foram alcançados e estabelecer a frequência dos atendimentos;
Consultar os registros do prontuário, pelo menos das últimas 24 horas antes de iniciar o atendimento do paciente, para compreender melhor o caso e assim ter condições de prestar uma assistência mais adequada;
Registrar no prontuário a evolução, após o atendimento do paciente, a fim de documentar a avaliação diária, conduta realizada, resposta do paciente à terapia, alterações de objetivos do tratamento e programação de novas condutas (se necessário), discussões com a equipe multidisciplinar e orientações fornecidas aos pacientes e seus familiares. A qualidade do registro em prontuário irá contribuir para garantir o acesso às informações do paciente e a continuidade do cuidado;
Indicar e orientar o uso de equipamento adaptativo e / ou tecnologia assistiva, a fim de facilitar o ganho funcional do paciente, incremento da independência e ganho de qualidade de vida;
Orientar e indicar adaptação de órtese bem como mudanças do estilo de vida, com orientação para manejo do tempo e conservação de energia;
Verificar a necessidade e escolher apropriadamente os recursos terapêuticos que serão utilizados para o atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente antes do iniciar o atendimento, com intuito de antecipar as demandas visando prestar uma assistência completa;
Monitorar constantemente todos os pacientes em acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional observando a evolução clínica e necessidade de intervenções, a fim de planejar melhor a assistência ao paciente;
Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto ao tratamento proposto e seus objetivos durante a internação e na alta, com consequente, orientação domiciliar;
Preencher a estatística de pacientes atendidos diariamente com objetivo de controle do número atendimentos realizados;
Conversar com familiares, pelo menos uma vez ao dia, a fim de explicar os objetivos do acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional e dar oportunidade para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
Seguir normas e rotinas estabelecidas pelo SCIH (Serviço de Controle de Infecções Hospitalar), consultando os documentos disponíveis no sistema GED (Gerenciador de Documentos) e participando dos treinamentos, com o intuito de aplicar as ações e contribuir para a prevenção de infecções hospitalares;
Prestar assistência nas unidades de internação quando houver necessidade da Instituição (por exemplo, diminuição do nº de pacientes que precisam da assistência de fisioterapia na UTI);
Consultar e-mail corporativo diariamente;
Informar a supervisão a respeito de queixas de pacientes/familiares ou problemas gerais;
Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos da área, conforme designado pelos líderes imediatos ou de acordo com a necessidade da área;
Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.
Qualificações Necessárias
Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
Conselho de Classe e Anuidade 2025 em dia;
Vivência anterior de pelo menos 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar ou ambulatorial, de acordo com o setor de trabalho;
Conhecimento intermediário do idioma Inglês;
Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, básico ou intermediário;
Cursos de aprimoramento ou atualização nas áreas assistenciais;
Desejável curso de Suporte Básico de Vida (BLS) ou similar;
Disponibilidade para atuar de Segunda à Sexta de 8 às 14 na região de Duque de Caxias.

Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.
Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Estamos em busca de um Estagiário(a) de Planejamento Financeiro que possa contribuir com o controle de custos da companhia, análises financeiras e elaboração de materiais estratégicos para liderança.

Apoiar nas análises financeiras para para elaboração de relatórios;
Apoiar na elaboração de apresentações e materiais de suporte para líderes.

Cursando Ensino Superior em Engenharias ou Economia, a partir do 4º período;

Glória, Rio de Janeiro.

Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade

title: Channel Team Lead
description:
O Channel Team Lead – Hub Delivery será responsável por supervisionar e orientar uma equipe de Executivos de Desenvolvimento de Conta (ADEs), encarregados da aquisição, integração e gestão de parceiros de varejo locais no programa Hub Delivery da Amazon no Brasil. Esta é uma função de liderança que combina execução em campo com visão estratégica, garantindo que os ADMs atinjam metas de aquisição, ativação e desempenho, sempre mantendo os altos padrões de entrega da Amazon. Key job responsibilities
Liderança e Coaching da Equipe

Garantir que os ADEs conduzam o desempenho dos parceiros para atingir ou superar a meta de 98,5% de entregas bem-sucedidas.
Identificar problemas sistêmicos nos territórios e implementar planos de ação corretivos.
Execução Estratégica
Alinhar as atividades da equipe com os objetivos regionais de crescimento do Hub Delivery.
Equilibrar a execução de curto prazo com a escalabilidade de longo prazo do programa.
Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para desafios complexos de parceiros ou operações, oferecendo soluções baseadas em dados.
Colaboração Multifuncional
Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de Operações, Last Mile e Programa para resolver problemas sistêmicos que impactam a qualidade da entrega.
Fornecer insights consolidados de campo para melhorar o design do programa, a experiência dos parceiros e a escalabilidade.

Demonstrar as melhores práticas em aquisição, integração e gestão de parceiros.

Experience using CRM tools

Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

description:

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de estrelas
Nós valorizamos a diversidade e sabemos que um time formado por pessoas com perfis diversos nos torna tão fortes e únicos quanto nossas marcas. Queremos inspirar e fazer parte da transformação de um mundo melhor para todas as pessoas. Não só para algumas. Esse é o nosso melhor e mais importante brinde
O Grupo HEINEKEN se orgulha de aumentar continuamente a representatividade de pessoas negras, pessoas com deficiência e mulheres no nosso time de estrelas. Esse é apenas o começo para inspiramos um mundo melhor e mais justo, onde o Respeito e o Cuidado são os nossos guias.
E ai, se identificou? Se você tem coragem para abraçar novos desafios e está a fim de fazer a diferença, vamos juntos transformar o mercado de bebidas. Acesse nossas oportunidades
Seu brilho transforma a nossa estrela
Missão do cargo
Responsável por garantir a execução das estratégias (FDS e Alavancas de Trade Marketing) em todos os canais atendidos pelo CDAs, fazendo a gestão do time direto e suportando o time de vendas, além de garantir um bom alinhamento com os principais stakeholders, visando maximizar os resultados das iniciativas da área e consequentemente da empresa.
Principais atribuições
Garantir a correta comunicação das ações de mercado ao time do CDA, sendo responsável pelo desdobramento das estratégias até a equipe de vendas.
Responsável pela correta execução das ações de Trade Marketing através das visitas em rota, acompanhamentos e planilhas (tracking) reportando oportunidades de melhoria e contribuindo para o fortalecimento das marcas dentro do ponto de venda.
Garantir a correta alocação de refrigerados e jogos de mesa, além de acompanhar o desempenho dos dos refrigeradores, seguindo os parâmetros e diretrizes definidas pelo Trade Marketing Corporativo.
Garantir a correta comunicação da ferramenta FDS (Fotografia de Sucesso), bem como sua correta execução no mercado, através da realização de rotas.
Garantir o correto planejamento dos materiais leves e semiduráveis, promovendo uma distribuição equilibrada entre os diferentes canais, com base na matriz de priorixação e FDS
Garantir o recebimento, estoque e distribuição dos materiais de merchandising (leve, semi-duráveis e pesados) para a equipe de vendas executar nos PDVs.
Direcionar a Equipe Comercial em negociações de mercado específicas que requeiram o uso de imagem das marcas, investimentos e patrocínios.
Atuar no atendimento de eventos patrocinados, garantindo a correta execução das estratégias propostas pelas marcas.
Cumprir todo o procedimento exigido pelo assessment da Fórmula Heineken.
Prospectar e/ou selecionar os PDVs informados pelo time comercial que receberão o aporte de investimento em contratos para o MF. Além de, fazer o acompanhamento do contrato (real vs assinado)
Liderar o processo de JBP nos clientes de ASI junto ao time comercial. Além de, fazer o acompanhamento da execução das contrapartidas assinadas em contrato
Responsável pela gestão de verba do BTL do CDA, bem como garantir a execução de todos os processos da cia: requisição de compras, TP, RC etc.
Responsável pela gestão do time (Merchandiser + Assistente de trade + Supervisor de trade ou Promotores)
